name: orichalcum
enchant_note: Atlantis' red metal hums with magic: it holds all you can give it.
protection_note: Atlantis' red metal, said to hum with magic: a caster can work in it.
protection_price: It conducts lightning, and it is found only near the bottom.
lore_descriptor: red-gold, the lost metal of Atlantis, worth a fortune even as scrap
first_pickup_chronicle: Found orichalcum armor, out of drowned Atlantis. Spells slide off it.
design_notes: Atlantean magical_metal. Strong AC + high enchant + magic-resist.
